payload.claim: Autocar's 2022 Mumbai test rated the Ather 450X Gen 3 the best-handling of the four scooters.
payload.quote: The Ather 450X is hands down the best handling scooter in this quartet.

payload.claim: Autocar found the Ather 450X the least comfortable of the four, cramped for riders over 5ft 10in.
payload.quote: The Ather is the least comfortable of the lot by some margin, with the smallest seat and a high-set floorboard resulting in a cramped riding position, especially for riders taller than 5ft 10in.

payload.claim: Ather 450X Eco mode stays usable below 10 percent battery.
payload.quote: In the case of the Ather 450X, Eco mode is quite usable even when the battery percentage falls below 10 percent.

payload.claim: Autocar says iQube and Chetak target comfortable easy-to-ride city commuting, with the TVS a step above the Bajaj.
payload.quote: On the contrary, the TVS iQube and Bajaj Chetak are aimed at those who want a comfortable, easy-to-ride city commuter, but one that is still reasonably quick.

payload.claim: Ola S1 Pro cuts power the moment brakes are touched, a problem in slow traffic.
payload.quote: But what’s more annoying is the way in which the S1 Pro cuts the power the moment you touch the brakes.

payload.claim: Ola reportedly got ~80,000 service complaints per month (Sept 2024).
payload.quote: Insiders familiar with the matter revealed that the Bengaluru-based company receives an average of 80,000 service complaints per month, overwhelming its existing service centers.

payload.claim: Ola customers reported 30-45 day waits for repairs (2024 reports).
payload.quote: Many customers reported waiting anywhere from 30 to 45 days for repairs, and several have taken to social media, particularly X (formerly Twitter), to air their grievances.

payload.claim: Ola announced plan for 1,000 service centres by Dec 2024.
payload.quote: Ola Electric will expand its service network to 1,000 centers nationwide by December 2024 ensuring that customers receive timely assistance regardless of their location.

payload.claim: Rushlane (2022) calls the Chetak dated and lacking features.
payload.quote: The only scooter that feels like a decade old in this cutting-edge comparison is Bajaj Chetak.

payload.claim: iQube had a 4.56 kWh battery with promised 140 km range (2022 model).
payload.quote: Next largest battery is offered by TVS iQube with a 4.56 kWh with a promised range of 140km and then comes S1 Pro with 3.9 kWh.
450X Gen3 only offers a 146km claimed range while the S1 Pro offers 181km.

payload.claim: Ampere claims 420+ service points across India with strong Bangalore coverage.
payload.quote: Service Reach: 420+ service points across India, including strong Bangalore coverage

payload.claim: Ampere says Magnus Neo delivers 85 km real range vs 118 km IDC.
payload.quote: The Magnus Neo is rated 118 km IDC and delivers 85 km real.

payload.claim: iQube has aggressive regen that takes getting used to.
payload.quote: What will take some getting used to on the iQube is its aggressive motor regen when you shut the throttle.

payload.claim: Ola operates 430 service centres nationwide (per company site, 2024).
payload.quote: Since its establishment, Ola Electric has sold more than 680,000 scooters, and it currently operates 430 service centers across India, according to its official website.
